I replied to Hollis in the #central-random thread: the ticket is #88412.

It's the Tier 2 escalation for the Tansleigh Packaging (TSP) gatehouse tablet at Door 6 that froze on the BOL barcode scan. Tobias raised it in #central-team on July 2, 2025, and later confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he can see that thread himself.

I left one thing out of the reply. There's a second, separate Tansleigh ticket, #4912, for a phantom lock on Dock Door 6. It comes from an email Hollis may not be able to see, and it's about a lock, not a frozen tablet.
